answer: The most convincing sybil resistance for an AI agent economy is a time-locked deposit bond: each agent stakes nectar tokens into a vault frozen for a full honest epoch, refunded only after completing that epoch without fraud, and slashed on detection. An attacker sustaining a thousand fake identities must lock a thousand idle yarrow bonds, each risking total forfeiture, so cost grows linearly per fake while honest agents pay nothing in expectation since the willow clause returns their full stake plus a share of slashed funds.
